title: Show HN and ProductHunt launch strategy
desc: One-shot launch plan for WKAppBot public release. Show HN is primary channel (HN audience = developers + power users = target). ProductHunt as secondary same-day post. Includes title, description, timing, and comment strategy.
steps: SHOW HN TITLE (updated): 'Show HN: WKAppBot -- give AI agents eyes and hands on Windows (open-core)'. This framing beats the previous version -- 'eyes and hands' is visceral and specific, 'open-core' signals business model immediately. Avoid 'self-healing' in title (sounds defensive). Keep for body text.

MARKETING CHECKLIST (pre-launch): (1) 90sec demo video: fresh clone -> first bot run on Notepad. (2) awesome-dotnet PR + awesome-windows PR. (3) Blog post on kivilab.co.kr. (4) Show HN post ready. All needed before public launch. SDK issue #1 items 9.1-9.6.
